description: Read-only catalog-hygiene audit policy for Assets/StreamingAssets/Data. Consumed by `ashfall-dev audit-catalogs` (tools/gotools/pkg/catalogaudit) and the `catalog_audit` CI gate. This is a fast static pre-flight over the authored JSON; the runtime authority for catalog cross-references remains Ashfall.Core.CatalogIntegrityValidator (--data-integrity-selftest).

id_domains.note: Registries that intentionally mirror ids from every domain. Excluded from cross-domain duplicate detection.
Journal entries keyed by doctrine id (intentional cross-file reuse of warlord_doctrine ids).
Broadcasts keyed by doctrine id (intentional cross-file reuse of warlord_doctrine ids).
Doctrine authority; owns the journal_warlord_*/radio_warlord_* reference ids.
Regional current table; carries a faction id from the faction domain.
Merged item catalog surface (all *_items.json + economy goods + ammo).
Canonical authored item authorities only (excludes the economy/ammo projections). Used as a reference target for G01/G02 so a market id must resolve to a real item.
Catch-all for catalogs that do not own entity ids (tuning, templates, prose).

reference_rules.note: Plan 76: expedition lootCategories are literal item ids, not abstract tags (generalizes the Plan76DestinationLootReferenceTests gate).
Plan 46 table bindings on authored destinations.
Wasteland-map salvage nodes forward this id as a scavenging_table_id.
G01: every economy good id must resolve to a canonical item (the 9mm_ammo class of bug). Three grandfathered market-projection ids are allowlisted.
G02: every combat ammo id must resolve to a canonical item.

reference_rules_excluded.reason: locations_expansion3.json uses abstract category tags (alloy_plates, rations, tools, ...), not item ids. Deliberately out of scope; do not add without an authored contract.
